notes.title: Where did the fabricators come from and how do you defeat them?
notes.content: [p]When the robots first arrived, these massive manufacturing hubs were used to produce commercial and consumer drones for trade and communications. Within a year they were retrofitted for war.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588195/753f88880b9848a78e124c6bfc60355a5b159a6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Break down the fabricator shields to shred the behemoth piece by piece until the last gear. But be careful, Space Cowboy. Poking the nest will rile the swarm. Destroying the outer shields for any segment of the fabricator will send that segment into a frenzy, spewing an endless swarm of enemies. Be strategic and methodical, and don't bite off more than you can chew.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588195/bd80c9ee2864cc3886f3bf4d5c9486bb4fc7b6ce.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Subscribe to our YouTube channel! [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@NonPolynomialTim"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Introducing: Space Cowboy
notes.content:
In a dark, not-so-distant future, the robot scourge reigns with a steel fist. Ruthless and insatiable, their goal is to seize and exploit finite resources across the universe. Corrupt local leaders sold their own planets in hopes of appeasing their new lords, but now cower powerlessly against a cold and uncompromising force. Resistance is rare, scattered, and hopelessly outgunned. As annihilation looms, a lone figure emerges from the shadows. No one knows his name, his past, or what forged his fury. But his mission is clear: kill every last robot in this galaxy and the next.
